title: OKR-driven launch slate and capacity ramp playbook for runtime/console/api alignment
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Goal: Create a prescriptive playbook and prioritization model that ties OKRs to a single launch slate and capacity ramp plan across Runtime, Console, and API surfaces. This ticket operationalizes how we decide what ships in each release window, how much dedicated capacity is reserved, and the gating criteria for cutover and rollback.

Problem: Multiple teams publish independent launch requests which leads to conflicts during peak capacity windows, unclear OKR alignment, and last-minute tradeoffs that increase latency/cost risk. We need a repeatable decision flow that: 1) maps features to OKR buckets, 2) ranks launch slate by customer and revenue impact vs operational cost, and 3) assigns capacity lanes and fallback policies for each launch window.

Scope: Build a prioritization matrix, a capacity ramp schedule, a preflight/runbook checklist, and a communication template for stakeholder coordination. Produce an operational dashboard with per-route token forecasts, SLO burn projections, and a launch readiness rubric that is consumed by release owners and on-call. Provide handoffs to Release Engineering for gating automation (feature flags, traffic ramps, and auto-fallback).
acceptance_criteria: Prioritization matrix defined and documented in Confluence with scoring weights mapped to top-level OKRs
Capacity ramp lanes (baseline, surge, emergency) defined with exact GPU-hour reservations per lane
Runbook template and preflight checklist created and validated by Runtime, Console, and API leads
Communication template and cadence (stakeholder sync, daily launch channel, cutover hour roster) published
Dashboard prototype (forecast + SLO burn) linked and accessible to release owners
Automated gating plan with feature flag play documented and assigned to Release Engineering
tasks: Draft prioritization matrix and weight proposals (owner: PM)
Collect historical token usage and peak windows from Console + Runtime telemetry (owner: Eng infra)
Define capacity lanes with exact reservations and fallback thresholds (owner: Capacity team)
Create preflight runbook and smoke test scripts for API/Console/Runtime (owner: SRE)
Prototype dashboard in Looker with per-route forecast and SLO burn (owner: Observability)
Run a dry-run simulation with 2 feature teams and document outcomes (owner: Release Manager)
Finalize communication and escalation play and publish to Confluence (owner: Program Manager)
